subject: Restart orchestrator daemon to serve /costflow
description: The orchestrator daemon source at /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator now includes a GET /costflow endpoint, merged-flag persistence on /git/merge, and a dashboard cost popup (merged to main at commit 3709287). The running daemon on http://localhost:8787 still serves the old code (GET /costflow returns 404). Restart the daemon process so the new code is live: find the running process (lsof -ti tcp:8787), kill it, and relaunch `node /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js` the same way it is normally supervised (check for a launchd plist or how it was last started; it persists its workspace in its data dir so it resumes serving /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude). Verify after restart: curl localhost:8787/costflow returns JSON with autonomy_score/results/waste/totals and curl localhost:8787/ping works, and the dashboard at http://localhost:8787/graph loads with the new '⚖ cost' control in the summary bar.
